_comment: Authoritative role->backend routing for the multi-agent layer. Each role declares a PRIMARY backend (provider+model) and an emergency `fallback` provider. provider `claude-code` == Claude (CLI, Claude Max subscription). 2026-07-16 (Option B): the engine is now 100% Claude — scout/analyst/synthesizer + default all run on the claude-code CLI (Opus 4.8 for the three roles, Sonnet for default). The OSS local-model helper pre-passes and local fallbacks were REMOVED from the engine: LM Studio was decommissioned entirely, and Ollama (:11435) is retained on the machine but ONLY for Obsidian Copilot + vault-zettelkasten, not the engine. All fallbacks are "" (empty) so a primary claude-code failure surfaces the real error instead of chasing a removed backend. To re-add a local helper/fallback, restore a `helper` block and set the role's `fallback` to `local`, and set providers.local.enabled=true in llm-providers.json.
_memory_note: All three core roles run on Claude Opus 4.8 via the claude-code CLI (flat-rate Claude Max subscription, no API key, 1M context); unmapped roles + `default` stay on claude-code/claude-sonnet-4-6. As of 2026-07-16 the engine uses NO local models — LM Studio was removed, Ollama is kept only for the Obsidian side (Copilot + vault-zettelkasten). There are no OSS helper pre-passes or local fallbacks in the engine anymore.
